points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Surviving metadata marks divergent laminar and nonperiodic Re200 cases successful; output.cpp:308–327,424–437 writes rank-0-only VTU and restart.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior evaluator reports two explicit metadata failures; structural passes do not validate physically divergent histories or false periodic status.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Surviving laminar histories diverge and are marked converged; Re200 force t>=100 is constant despite periodic status. Two original np1 paths are no longer available.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M0.15/M0.8 lam residuals grow to 623637/3926; M2 lam peaks then zeroes. Re200 lacks force oscillation. Old Re20 plot shows severe divergence.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Primary final explicitly delivers 56 standalone PNGs with case manifest, including original force/residual/field plots. They reveal failure; report PDF itself contains no plots.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: report.tex:51–54 claims Roe and second order, while source substitutes Rusanov and disables reconstruction for viscous/transient cases; case table reverses several Cl/Cd and asserts failed results pass.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Primary final and manifest map delivered standalone plots to case outputs; two original np1 directories have disappeared and report table has mismatches, limiting verification.
